title: Brik organizational policy file
description: DSI-owned policy file distributed via the referential.s Policy document. Carries the optional preset override (project preset is the default) and the org-wide allowlists for CVEs and paths. Equipes projet n'editent jamais ce fichier; toute exception passe par un PR sur le repo DSI.

preset.description: Optional override of the project's brik.yml quality.findings.policy preset. When present, the org preset wins over the project preset. Absent means the project preset is retained.

state_repo_protection.description: Posture of the state-repo branch-protection gate at deploy. 'required' refuses to deploy when the branch is unprotected or the check cannot run (fail-closed, the enterprise posture); 'warn' logs loudly and continues (the lab posture before its first hardening tier); 'off' skips the check. Absent means 'warn'.

allow.description: Org-wide allowlists. Each entry MUST carry both reason and expires; permanent allowlists are not supported by design.

cve.description: CVE allowlist. Each entry suppresses findings whose ruleId matches the CVE id, optionally scoped to a list of projects.

id.description: CVE identifier in the CVE-YYYY-NNNN... canonical form.

reason.description: Human-readable rationale for the suppression. Required by governance; usually references an architecture or compliance ticket.

expires.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) after which the entry is silently ignored by the runtime; the finding then re-enters the failing set.

projects.description: Optional list of project names (matched against BRIK_PROJECT_NAME with exact equality, no wildcards in v1). Absent means the entry applies to every project.

paths.description: Path allowlist. Each entry suppresses findings whose location.physicalLocation.artifactLocation.uri matches the glob, optionally scoped to a list of projects.

glob.description: Glob pattern matched against the SARIF artifactLocation URI (e.g. vendor/**, legacy/**).

expires.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) after which the entry is silently ignored by the runtime.

projects.description: Optional list of project names (exact match against BRIK_PROJECT_NAME). Absent means the entry applies to every project.
